data.long_meaning: The name Cebo is derived from the Greek word κεβος (kebos), meaning 'offering' or 'gift.' In a biblical context, this name can be interpreted as a reminder of the greatest gift of all - God's love and sacrifice. The name Cebo carries the meaning “Gift of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Cebo usually hope their child will grow to embody gift of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_latin.name: Cebo
